breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: An adenoid cystic carcinoma arising from the salivary gland. It is characterized by the presence of epithelial and myoepithelial cells forming tubular, cribriform, and solid patterns. It usually presents as a slow growing mass. Patients may experience pain because of the tumor propensity for perineural invasion. The tumor may follow an aggressive clinical course with recurrences and mestastases to distant sites including lungs, bones, brain, and liver.

adenoid cystic carcinoma of the salivary gland

mechanisms: Stem cell growth factor receptor inhibitor

master.definition_en: Primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) is a chronic and slowly progressive cholestatic liver disease of autoimmune etiology characterized by injury of the intrahepatic bile ducts that may eventually lead to liver failure.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 自身免疫慢性破坏肝内小胆管导致胆汁淤积，若对一线治疗应答不佳且未及时加用二线药物，10–20年内可进展为失代偿期肝硬化、食管胃底静脉曲张破裂出血或肝衰竭。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 约60%–70%患者单用熊去氧胆酸（UDCA）可实现生化应答并获得接近常人的预期寿命；对UDCA应答不佳的30%–40%患者，联合PPAR激动剂（Elafibranor、Seladelpar或非诺贝特/苯扎贝特）可显著改善ALP与瘙痒症状。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Orphanet与全球死因统计未单列PBC独立年度死亡数；UDCA充分应答者生存率接近普通人群，未控制者10年生存率显著下降并需肝移植。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国未单列PBC独立死亡统计；随着抗线粒体抗体（AMA）筛查普及，国内确诊病例逐年增多。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球患病率约20–40/10万，好发于40–60岁女性（欧美男女比例约1:9至1:10）。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 系统综述估算中国普通人群PBC患病率约40–120/10万（检出率受年龄与地区筛查影响，女性仍占明显优势，男女比例约1:3至1:6）。

master.definition_en: A well-circumscribed mass composed of tuberculous granulation tissue that may occur in the cerebral hemispheres, cerebellum, brain stem, or perimeningeal spaces. Multiple lesions are quite common. Management of intracranial manifestations vary with lesion site. Intracranial tuberculomas may be associated with seizures, focal neurologic deficits, and intracranial hypertension. Spinal cord tuberculomas may be associated with localized or radicular pain, weakness, sensory loss, and incontinence. Tuberculomas may arise as opportunistic infections, but also occur in immunocompetent individuals.

master.definition_en: Acute hemorrhagic leukoencephalitis(AHL) is a veryrareform of acute disseminated encephalomyelitis that usuallyresults indeath. It is characterized by a brief but intense attack of inflammation in the brain and spinal cord that damages the myelin -- the protective covering of the nerve fibers. It may also cause bleeding in the brain, leading to damage of the white matter. Symptoms usually come on quickly, beginning with symptoms such as fever, neck stiffness, fatigue, headache, nausea vomiting,seizures, and coma.AHL has a very poor prognosis, with rapid deterioration and death usually occurring within days to one week after onset of symptoms because of severe inflammation in the brain. Although the exact cause is unclear,AHL usually followsaviral infection, or less often, vaccination for measles, mumps, or rubella. Some researchers think that an infection or vaccination can initiate an autoimmune process in the body thus leading to AHL.

Mild cognitive impairment has also rarely been reported.

master.name_en: intellectual developmental disorder with language impairment and early-onset DOPA-responsive dystonia-parkinsonism
master.definition_en: A rare genetic neurological disorder characterized by early-onset global developmental delay, intellectual disability, speech and language impairment, early-onset hypotonia and movement abnormalities (including dystonia and parkinsonism) that are usually L-dopa responsive. Various types of seizures (including tonic-clonic, focal, generalized and absence seizures, infantile spasms and rolandic epilepsy) and behavioral problems (including autism, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, tantrums, anxiety, and hyposensitivity to temperature and pain) are also reported in the majority of the patients. The severity of the symptoms varies, ranging from mild to severe. Mildly affected individuals exhibit normal early development until the first symptoms appear in infancy including delayed speech and mild intellectual disability. Additional clinical features may include abnormal eye movements, trichotillomania, feeding and sleeping difficulties. Patients may harbor 2q24 microdeletion including the NR4A2 gene or have de novo mutations in this gene.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
